**SECTION D: ESSAY – 10 MARKS**

Write an essay between 250 - 300 words on any ONE of the following topics.

questions.enonce_markdown: 1. Describe a nature disaster in your locality and its effect on the environment.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai descriptif suit une structure en trois temps : une introduction qui situe le sujet (lieu, moment, nature de l'événement), un développement qui décrit les faits et leurs effets de façon organisée (chronologique ou thématique), et une conclusion qui tire un enseignement ou une réflexion de l'événement décrit. Le respect du nombre de mots imposé (250-300 mots) fait partie des critères de notation.

### Corrigé
Natural disasters can strike any community without warning, and my own locality was no exception. Last rainy season, the town of Limbe, where I live, experienced one of the worst floods in recent years.

The disaster began after three consecutive days of heavy rainfall. The Limbe River, which usually flows calmly through the town, overflowed its banks within a few hours. Muddy water rushed into the streets, submerging houses, shops and farmland along the riverbanks. Many families had to abandon their homes in the middle of the night, carrying only what they could grab in a hurry. By morning, several neighbourhoods were completely under water, and roads leading to the town centre had become impassable.

The effects of the flood on the environment were considerable. Fertile farmland along the river was covered with a thick layer of mud and debris, destroying crops that farmers depended on for their livelihood. Numerous trees were uprooted, and the riverbank itself was severely eroded, leaving the soil more vulnerable to future flooding. Stagnant water left behind after the flood became a breeding ground for mosquitoes, increasing the risk of malaria in the following weeks. The local drainage system, already poorly maintained, was further damaged, worsening drainage problems for subsequent rains.

This flood taught the whole community an important lesson about environmental management. Since then, local authorities have started clearing drainage channels regularly and have discouraged construction too close to the riverbanks. Trees are also being replanted along the banks to reduce erosion.

Natural disasters cannot always be prevented, but their impact on the environment can certainly be reduced through better planning, regular maintenance of drainage systems, and greater respect for natural water channels.

### Piège à éviter
Ne te contente pas de raconter l'événement sans jamais mentionner ses effets sur l'environnement : le sujet demande explicitement de décrire à la fois le désastre ET ses conséquences environnementales, les deux doivent apparaître clairement dans la copie.

### Conseil
Compte approximativement tes mots en comptant les lignes de ton brouillon (une ligne manuscrite standard compte environ 10 à 12 mots) : cela évite de rendre un essai trop court, systématiquement pénalisé, ou trop long, qui fait perdre du temps sur les autres sections.

questions.enonce_markdown: 2. What are the advantages and disadvantages of global changes to human activities?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai de type "avantages et inconvénients" (for and against) exige un plan équilibré : une partie consacrée aux avantages, une partie consacrée aux inconvénients, et une conclusion qui prend position ou nuance le débat. Chaque avantage ou inconvénient doit être développé avec un exemple concret, pas seulement énoncé.

### Corrigé
Over the past few decades, the world has undergone rapid global changes that have transformed almost every human activity, from the way we work to the way we communicate. Like most major transformations, these changes bring both advantages and disadvantages.

On the positive side, global changes have made communication faster and easier than ever before. Thanks to the internet and mobile technology, people can now work, study and exchange information with others located thousands of kilometres away. Trade has also become more efficient, allowing countries to access goods and services that were previously unavailable locally, which has improved living standards for many communities. In addition, access to information has increased considerably, giving people in remote areas the opportunity to learn new skills online and improve their education.

However, these changes also carry serious disadvantages. Traditional ways of life and local cultures are sometimes lost as global habits, largely influenced by wealthier countries, spread and replace local customs. Global changes to human activities, particularly increased industrial production and transportation, have also contributed heavily to environmental problems such as pollution and climate change. Furthermore, not everyone benefits equally from these changes: while some regions and individuals prosper, others are left behind, which can widen the gap between rich and poor.

In conclusion, global changes to human activities have undeniably improved communication, trade and access to information, but they have also weakened local cultures, damaged the environment and increased inequality. Societies should therefore try to benefit from these changes while putting in place policies that protect the environment, preserve local cultures and ensure that progress benefits everyone.

### Piège à éviter
N'écris pas un essai entièrement à charge (uniquement les avantages ou uniquement les inconvénients) : le sujet demande explicitement les deux aspects, un essai déséquilibré perd des points même s'il est bien écrit.

### Conseil
Réserve environ un tiers de ton essai à l'introduction et à la conclusion, et répartis le reste équitablement entre avantages et inconvénients : cette structure claire est immédiatement reconnaissable par le correcteur et valorisée dans la notation.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Le plan équilibré de l'essai avantages/inconvénients

questions.enonce_markdown: 3. Identify four problems faced by the youths in your society and suggest possible solutions.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai de type "problèmes et solutions" doit associer clairement chaque problème identifié à au moins une solution correspondante, plutôt que de lister tous les problèmes d'abord puis toutes les solutions ensuite sans lien explicite entre eux : cette structure appariée facilite la lecture et la notation.

### Corrigé
Young people in my society today face a number of serious challenges that affect their future. Four of these problems deserve particular attention, along with possible solutions.

The first major problem is unemployment. Many young graduates struggle to find jobs even after completing their studies, largely because there are not enough opportunities to match the number of job seekers. A possible solution would be for the government and private companies to invest more in vocational training programmes and to support young entrepreneurs through low-interest loans and mentorship schemes.

The second problem is the lack of access to quality education, particularly in rural areas where schools are poorly equipped and teachers are scarce. Building more schools, training more qualified teachers and providing scholarships for students from disadvantaged backgrounds would help address this gap.

The third problem is drug and substance abuse, which has become increasingly common among teenagers and young adults, often as a way of escaping frustration or peer pressure. Awareness campaigns in schools, combined with accessible counselling services, could help young people resist this temptation and seek healthier ways of coping with difficulties.

The fourth problem is the lack of recreational and cultural facilities, which leaves many young people with little to do in their free time, sometimes pushing them towards harmful behaviour. Local authorities could invest in sports centres, libraries and youth clubs where young people can develop their talents and spend their free time constructively.

In conclusion, unemployment, poor access to education, substance abuse and the lack of recreational facilities are among the most pressing problems faced by youths in my society. With coordinated efforts from government, families and communities, these problems can be significantly reduced, giving young people a real chance to build a better future.

### Piège à éviter
Ne mélange pas des problèmes trop proches les uns des autres (par exemple deux formulations différentes du même problème de chômage) : les quatre problèmes doivent être clairement distincts pour montrer une réflexion variée sur le sujet.

### Conseil
Consacre un paragraphe distinct à chaque problème et sa solution associée : cette organisation visuelle claire aide le correcteur à identifier rapidement que les quatre éléments demandés sont bien présents.
